visual.general_description: Photograph of a printed 12-lead ECG tracing on pink gridded paper.
visual.detailed_description: The paper is photographed at a slight angle with a curved edge on a light surface; the image is low resolution and blurry. The tracing is arranged in four columns of three rows. Printed lead labels read I, II, III in the left column, aVR, aVL, aVF in the second column, V1, V2, V3 in the third column and V4, V5, V6 in the fourth column. A rectangular calibration pulse is visible beside each column. Lead I shows narrow upright spikes; leads II and III show small downward spikes followed by rounded upward waves; aVR shows downward spikes; V1 to V3 show deep downward deflections followed by rounded upward waves; V4 to V6 show narrow upright spikes. The baseline drifts in several leads. Header text printed along the top is partly blurred: it includes speed, gain and filter settings, a Name label and an ID label whose entries look empty, a sex word, an age field and a date and time stamp at the upper right. A numeric stamp is printed at the lower left and a red stamp with a circled mark at the bottom. A solid black rectangle covers part of the bottom edge of the paper. No rhythm-strip label or interpretation text is visible.
